note: Single-source table for reason strings the bridge invents (not owned by substrate or by signals/0.1.json § layer_2). Both the Python bridge and the TypeScript renderer read this file so a rename lands in one place. Companion to signals/0.1.json v0.1 — not a vocabulary change, just a code-side constants table. Cited by REVIEW-2026-09-11-code-style-and-fake-data #6.

substrate_envelope_kinds.note: Mirrored from substrate.topologies.session.vocabulary + tool_loop for the TypeScript side. Python reads them directly from that module (see bridge/vocab.py). Any rename in substrate lands here in one place; grep-attributable drift.

tool_names.note: Tool names substrate's tool_loop suite exports. Mirrored from substrate.topologies.tool_loop.tools TOOL_NAME_* constants for the TypeScript side; the Python bridge imports them directly (see bridge/vocab.py).

bridge_ops.note: Every op name the bridge accepts on stdin. bridge/vocab.py's BridgeOp StrEnum asserts on import that its member values equal this object's values; src/observability/bridge-ops.ts derives a mirror BridgeOp const the TS caller uses in place of raw strings. Added 2026-09-12 per REVIEW-2026-09-11-checkpoint extension (H23 class — hand-maintained op strings drift).

delegate_error_prefixes.note: Error-text substrings substrate.topologies.tool_loop.delegate.py raises for named terminal cases. Mirrored here so the reducer picks the correct Layer 5 terminal on a ToolResult(ok=false); the harness greps delegate.py at run time to fail loudly on substrate rename.
